column1: Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.

Rest is not idleness, and to lie sometimes on the grass under trees on a summer's day, listening to the murmur of the water, or watching the clouds float across the sky, is by no means a waste of time.
The time to relax is when you don't have time for it.
Sometimes the most productive thing you can do is relax.
Take rest; a field that has rested gives a bountiful crop.
Tension is who you think you should be. Relaxation is who you are.
Sleep is the best meditation.
If you can't change your fate, change your attitude.
The mind is like a parachute — it works best when it's open.
What seems to us as bitter trials are often blessings in disguise.
You should sit in nature for 20 minutes a day. Unless you're busy, then you should sit for an hour.
In the midst of movement and chaos, keep stillness inside of you.
The greatest weapon against stress is our ability to choose one thought over another.
A calm mind brings inner strength and self-confidence, so that's very important for good health.
Time you enjoy wasting was not wasted.
Give yourself a break. Stop and rest. Your mind will thank you.
Do not confuse motion and progress. A rocking horse keeps moving but does not make any progress.
The tree that is unbending is easily broken.
There is virtue in work and there is virtue in rest. Use both and overlook neither.
Relaxation is a form of meditation, and in the quiet of the mind, we find the solution to our problems.
The soul always knows what to do to heal itself. The challenge is to silence the mind.
Stress is caused by being 'here' but wanting to be 'there.'
Now and then it's good to pause in our pursuit of happiness and just be happy.
Rest when you're weary. Refresh and renew yourself, your body, your mind, your spirit. Then get back to work.
It is not a luxury to rest. It is a necessity.
Within you, there is a stillness and a sanctuary to which you can retreat at any time.
Almost everything comes from nothing.
There is a certain kind of peace that comes from stepping away from the noise.
If you get tired, learn to rest, not to quit.
For fast-acting relief, try slowing down.
The mind is not a vessel to be filled, but a fire to be kindled.
Rest and self-care are so important. When you take time to replenish your spirit, it allows you to serve others from the overflow.
Breathe. Let go. And remind yourself that this very moment is the only one you know you have for sure.
Nothing can bring you peace but yourself.
In the pause between thoughts, there is peace.
The more you are motivated by love, the more fearless and free your action will be.
A step backward after making a wrong turn is a step in the right direction.
Your mind will answer most questions if you learn to relax and wait for the answer.
Every now and then go away, have a little relaxation, for when you come back to your work your judgment will be surer.
Peace is not the absence of noise, trouble, or hard work. It is to be in the midst of those things and still be calm in your heart.
The ability to be in the present moment is a major component of mental wellness.
Slowing down is not a luxury, it's a necessity for a well-lived life.
You don't have to be positive all the time. It's perfectly okay to feel sad, angry, annoyed, frustrated, scared, or anxious. Having feelings doesn't make you a negative person. It makes you human.
The best way to capture moments is to pay attention. This is how we cultivate mindfulness.
Don't underestimate the value of doing nothing.
The pause between notes is what makes the music.
Sometimes you need to step outside, get some air, and remind yourself of who you are and who you want to be.
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
All of humanity's problems stem from man's inability to sit quietly in a room alone.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
To sit with the stillness of your own heart is the greatest gift you can give yourself.
Sometime the most urgent thing you can possibly do is take a complete rest.
When you recover or discover something that nourishes your soul and brings joy, care enough about yourself to make room for it.
Take a deep breath. It's just a bad day, not a bad life.
You can't pour from an empty cup. Take care of yourself first.
Let yourself be drawn by the stronger pull of that which you truly love.
Worrying is like paying a debt you don't owe.
The quieter you become, the more you can hear.
Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power to choose our response. In our response lies our growth and our freedom.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Be gentle with yourself. You are a child of the universe, no less than the trees and the stars.
Your calm mind is the ultimate weapon against your challenges.
The mind is like water. When it's turbulent, it's difficult to see. When it's calm, everything becomes clear.
Burnout is nature's way of telling you you've been going through the motions when your soul has departed.
If you want to be creative, you have to rest and let your mind wander.
Some of the most beautiful things in the world come from silence.
Step outside. The air is still there, waiting for you.
There's no need to fix everything. Sometimes just breathing is enough.
Pause and remember: you are exactly where you need to be.
Joy is not in things; it is in us.
Think of all the beauty still left around you and be happy.
The sun is a daily reminder that we too can rise again from the darkness, that we too can shine.
Be where you are, not where you think you should be.
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
A seed grows with no sound, but a tree falls with a huge noise. Destruction has noise, but creation is quiet.
Stillness is not about focusing on nothingness; it's about creating a clear space in which you can think.
Sometimes, to stay alive, you have to kill the version of yourself that's trying to do everything.
Not all those who wander are lost.
The most precious gift we can offer others is our presence. When mindfulness embraces those we love, they will bloom like flowers.
If you're overwhelmed, start small. Take a breath. Drink water. The rest will follow.
Don't let your mind bully your body into believing it must carry the burden of its worries.
An empty lantern provides no light. Rest is not a waste of time. It is fuel for the soul.
Every breath we take, every step we make, is filled with peace and joy.
You are allowed to be both a masterpiece and a work in progress, simultaneously.
The act of resting is the act of reclaiming yourself.
Turn your face to the sun and the shadows fall behind you.
This moment is the only moment that exists. Be here now.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
You are not your productivity. Your worth is not measured by what you produce.
The magic you are looking for is in the work you are avoiding.
Nothing can dim the light that shines from within.
The body achieves what the mind believes.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes courage is the little voice at the end of the day that says, 'I'll try again tomorrow.'
To keep a lamp burning, we have to keep putting oil in it.
Nearly every great discovery came from someone who was taking a break from what they were supposed to be doing.
Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
In the middle of the ordinary, there is always something extraordinary.
You have been criticizing yourself for years, and it hasn't worked. Try approving of yourself and see what happens.
